notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain one life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Shalai and Hallar triggers for each creature who had a counter placed on it this way.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain one life.
Repeat from step 3.
